original: ucyate | na dṛśyena vyabhicāreṇa vyavastheyam apanetuṃ śakyate, kadācitkatvād vyabhicārasya | pratyakṣādiṣv api pramāṇeṣu dṛśyata eva tādṛśo vyabhicāraḥ, na ca tāni na pramāṇam | atha vyabhicāravanti naiva pratyakṣādiśabdavācyāni | yad vyabhicarati na tat pratyakṣam,[121] yat pratyakṣaṃ na tad vyabhicaratīti vacanāt | ihāpi śakyate tad vaktum | vyabhicaratīty asau[122] na[123] śapathaḥ, yaḥ śapathaḥ sa na vyabhicaratīti | kaḥ punaḥ śapathaḥ | yaḥ samatetikartavyatāmātrādyapagrahaṇanirūpitakuhakastaṃbhanābhāvaḥ[124] | viparīto 'śapathaḥ | na tādṛśasya vyabhicāro 'sti | athāpi syāt, tatrāpi prākkṛtasya karmaṇaḥ phalavipāko bhavati, nimittatvāt | kṛtāparādho[125] 'pi pūrvakṛtena garīyasāśubhena mucyate | akṛtāparādho janmāntaradoṣeṇa nigṛhyate | vicitrā hi karmaṇāṃ phalapākābhivyaktihetavaḥ | sahasrād eko mithyā gṛhyate | utsargas[126] tv amithyātvam | putreṣṭikārīyādiṣv apy etat samānam |
analyzed: ucyate na dṛśyena vyabhicāreṇa vyavastheyam apanetum śakyate kadācitkatvāt vyabhicārasya pratyakṣa ādiṣu api pramāṇeṣu dṛśyate eva tādṛśaḥ vyabhicāraḥ na ca tāni na pramāṇam atha vyabhicāravanti na eva pratyakṣa ādi śabda vācyāni yat vyabhicarati na tat pratyakṣam yat pratyakṣam na tat vyabhicarati iti vacanāt iha api śakyate tat vaktum vyabhicarati iti asau na śapathaḥ yaḥ śapathaḥ sa na vyabhicarati iti kaḥ punar śapathaḥ yaḥ samatā iti kart

original: tasmāt sākṣivac chapathe 'pi pratyetavya | te 'pi hi kadācin mithyāvadanti[127] | na bhayapradarśanamātram etat | yathāsthānarūḍhāḥ[128] śapathā uktāḥ satyaṃ pratiṣṭhata iti || 8.116 ||

original: lobhād yo vitathaṃ vakti sa sahasraṃ daṇḍanīya ity evaṃ yojanā[133] kartavyā | tatra yaḥ parasmād dhanam upādāya viaparītaṃ vakti tasya lobho hetuḥ | mohāt vaicittyāt[134] | yathārthavādī yathadṛṣṭārthavādī ca kenacic cittasaṃkṣobhahetunā praśnakāle vyāmūḍhaḥ[135] samyak praśnārtham anavadhāryāsmṛtatvād vānyathā brūyāt sa mohād ity ucyate | bhayaṃ trāsaḥ | yadi madīyena[136] satyavacanenāyaṃ jīyeta, tatrāyaṃ kadācit jñātidhanādibādhayā māṃ vyāpādayed ity āśaṅkā | sahasram iti saṃkhyeyaviśeṣāvagatir vākyāntarāt paṇānām iti | pūrvaṃ tu sāhasaṃ prathamam "paṇānāṃ[137] dve śate sārdham" (MD 8.138) ityādau | dvau madhyamau sāhasāv iti vipariṇāmaḥ | pūrvaṃ caturguṇaṃ sahasram evety arthaḥ | vṛttānurodhena vicitrayā śabdavṛttyā sa evārthaḥ kathyate || 8.119–20 ||
analyzed: lobhāt yaḥ vitatham vakti sa sahasram daṇḍanīyaḥ iti evam yojanā kartavyā tatra yaḥ parasmāt dhanam upādāya viaparītam vakti tasya lobhaḥ hetuḥ mohāt vaicittyāt yathārtha vādī yathadṛṣṭārtha vādī ca kenacid citta saṃkṣobha hetunā praśna kāle vyāmūḍhaḥ samyak praśna artham an avadhārya asmṛta tvāt vā anyathā brūyāt sa mohāt iti ucyate bhayam trāsaḥ yadi madīyena satya vacanena ayam jīyeta tatra ayam kadācid jñāti dhana ādi bādhayā mām anu

original: ucyate | naikajātīyatvamātreṇa sārūpyaṃ bhavati, kiṃ tu vayaḥparimāṇādisāmyena | ato yukto bhedopanyāsaḥ | bhogalābhe 'pi kuto dvaiguṇyapratītiḥ | upakārakāṇi[311] janayatuṃ gāvaḥ prayujyante | gobhūmyādi payoyavasādayo yathāsaṃbhavaṃ bhujyante | tatra kīdṛśaṃ dvaiguṇyam | samācāraś ca kvacid dṛśyate | varṣaśatāni bhūmir ā mūlahiraṇyādānād bhujyate | paṭhati ca yājñavalkyaḥ: "ādhiś ca bhujyate tāvad yāvat tan na pradīyate" (YDh 2.93) iti |

original: atrocyate | vṛddhimātre śrūyamāṇe dvaiguṇyaṃ kathaṃ viseṣe 'vasthāpyate | na hi śrutyā[312] sāmānyapratipattir bhavantī vinā pramāṇena viśeṣe 'vasthātum arhati | yat tu saṃtatāv anupapannaṃ dvaiguṇyam iti, avagame yatnaḥ kriyatām | mūlamarṣeṇa pariniścitavatā vṛddhis tatsāmānyā yata[313] eva tajjātānāṃ bhavati | bhūmibhoge 'pi yavasagodhūmādau tatpacyamānasyārghataḥ[314] śakyata eva samatvaṃ niścetum | upakāravacano 'pi guṇaśabdo 'sti | ka evaṃ sati samaguṇo bhavati ka upakārako bhavatīti kathaṃ[315] gamyate | anena yāvan mūlyaṃ godhānyavinimayād utpadyate tāvad eva cet tata utpannā vṛddhis tadā bhavati samaguṇatvam, parimāṇādisāmyābhāve 'pi | yas tu kvacit samācāraḥ: bhavataiva parihṛtaḥ kvacid grahaṇaṃ prayuñjānena[316] | samācārabhraṃśasaṃbhave smṛtayo niyāmikā arthavatyaḥ |
analyzed: atrā ucyate vṛddhi mātre śrūyamāṇe dvaiguṇyam katham viseṣe vasthāpyate na hi śrutyā sāmānya pratipattiḥ bhavantī vinā pramāṇena viśeṣe vasthātum arhati yat tu saṃtatau anupapannam dvaiguṇyam iti avagame yatnaḥ kriyatām mūla marṣeṇa pariniścitavatā vṛddhiḥ tad sāmānyā yatas eva tad jātānām bhavati bhūmi bhoge pi yavasa godhūma ādau tat pacyamānasya arghataḥ śakyate eva sama tvam niścetum upakāra vacanaḥ u pi guṇa śabdaḥ sti kaḥ evam sati

original: "akṣīṇi me darśanīyāni pādā me sukumāratarāḥ" ityvat prayogād bahuṣu[317] bahuvacanam iti śāstram ārabhyate | asati viprayogadarśane pratyākhyāyate | upasarjanopasargapaurvāparyaprayogasiddhyartham uktam | na hi kaścit prapacatīti prayoktavye pacati prete prayuṅkta iti | vacanam api[318] "ādhis tu bhujyate tāvad yāvat tan na pradīyate"[319] yāvad dānāt taddviguṇam apraviṣṭam, ity api śakyate netum | smṛtyantaraivākyatvāc caitad eva yuktam adhyavasātum | upapāditaṃ caitan nipuṇato 'nyatra |
analyzed: akṣīṇi me darśanīyāni pādāḥ me sukumāratarāḥ ityvat prayogāt bahuṣu bahuvacanam iti śāstram ārabhyate asati viprayoga darśane pratyākhyāyate upasarjana upasarga paurvāparya prayoga siddhi artham uktam na hi kaścid prapacati iti prayoktavye pacati prete prayuṅkte iti vacanam api ādhiḥ tu bhujyate tāvat yāvat tat na pradīyate yāvat dānāt tad dviguṇam apraviṣṭam iti api śakyate netum smṛti antarā eva ākya tvāt ca etat eva yuktam adhyavasātum upapāditam ca eta

original: sakṛd āhitā | sakṛd ity anena vyavasthāpito 'ṅgīkṛtaḥ punaḥ punaḥ proyoga iti yāvat | ādhānaṃ sthāpanaṃ ucyate | vacanavyavasthayā ca nirūpaṇaṃ sthāpanam eva | punaḥ prayogaś ca[320] dviguṇībhūte dhane ādīyamāne bhavati | yadā dviguṇavṛddhyartham[321] uttamarṇaḥ, adhamarṇaś ca tadīyena dhanena mahatkāryaṃ kariṣyan karaṇaparivṛttiṃ karotīti yā prāktanī vṛddhir iyaṃ vādyaprabhṛti vardhata iti, tadā dviguṇabhūtam api punar vardhata eva | puruṣāntarasaṃcāreṇa vā yadi dviguṇībhūtaṃ dhanikasyopayujyate, tadādhamarṇa ucyamāno 'nyapuruṣaṃ dadatam arpayati "eṣa ta iyadbhir ahobhir dāsyati" iti tatra svahastaṃ dīyamānaṃ punar varddhate | na cāyaṃ dānaṃ prati pratipratibhūḥ kiṃ tu nikṣeptā dātaiva | etat tu ṛjunā "puruṣāntaram asaṃkrāntam" (Bhār on MDh 8.150; p. 113) iti vyākhyātam |
analyzed: sakṛt āhitā sakṛt iti anena vyavasthāpitaḥ ṅgīkṛtaḥ punar punar proyogaḥ iti yāvat ādhānam sthāpanam ucyate vacana vyavasthayā ca nirūpaṇam sthāpanam eva punar prayogaḥ ca dviguṇībhūte dhane ādīyamāne bhavati yadā dviguṇa vṛddhi artham uttamarṇaḥ adhamarṇaḥ ca tadīyena dhanena mahatkāryam kariṣyan karaṇa parivṛttim karoti iti yā prāktanī vṛddhiḥ iyam vādya prabhṛti vardhate iti tadā dviguṇa bhūtam api punar vardhate eva puruṣa artha ap

original: atha vā prāg api dvaiguṇyād yadā bandham anyasmai pratyarpayati, dīnāreṣu salābheṣu dvitve, tasya bandhasya mokṣa eva dharmyaḥ[322] | bandhasya prāgvṛddhau sthitāyāṃ tasmād ahnaḥ prabhṛti punar dvaiguṇyam āpnoti | yadā tadīyaṃ bandhakaṃ tadanujñayottamarṇenānyatrādhāya svadhanaṃ gṛhyate tadā vardhate | eṣa puruṣāntarasaṃcāraḥ |
analyzed: atha vā prāk api dvaiguṇyāt yadā bandham anyasmai pratyarpayati dīnāreṣu sa lābheṣu dvi tve tasya bandhasya mokṣaḥ eva dharmyaḥ bandhasya prāk vṛddhau sthitāyām tasmāt ahnaḥ prabhṛti punar dvaiguṇyam āpnoti yadā tadīyam bandhakam tad anujñayā uttamarṇena anyatra ādhāya sva dhanam gṛhyate tadā vardhate eṣa puruṣa antara saṃcāraḥ

original: ubhayatra[323] dviguṇībhūte prayoktādhamarṇikena yena kena[324] prakāreṇānyasmād grahaṇam anujñāpyate | yadi vāsmād anyad gṛhyate, grahītā deśāntaraṃ gamiṣyan kāryāntareṇa cānyatra saṃcārayati | ṛjus (=Bhār) tu tasmād evādharmarṇād anavīkṛte prayoge dviguṇādhikāṃ vṛddhiṃ necchati | ata āha puruṣāntaram asaṃkrānte punaḥkriyā | prayojanaṃ ca vakṣyāmaḥ |
analyzed: ubhayatra dviguṇībhūte prayoktā adhamarṇikena yena kena prakāreṇa anyasmāt grahaṇam anujñāpyate yadi vā asmāt anyat gṛhyate grahītā deśa antaram gamiṣyan kārya antareṇa ca anyatra saṃcārayati tu tasmāt eva adharmarṇāt anavīkṛte prayoge dviguṇa adhikām vṛddhim na icchati atas āha puruṣa antaram a saṃkrānte punaḥkriyā prayojanam ca vakṣyāmaḥ

original: ye tu vyācakṣate: "yā vṛddhir upacitā sāṃvatsarī yugapat sarvaivānīyate[325] tatrāyaṃ vidhiḥ | yā punaḥ prāptadānāpi sarvā na dīyate tatra dvigunād adhikagrahaṇam api," teṣāṃ na naśabdo yathārtho nāpy āhita iti | sāṃvatsarī tāvad upacitā grāhyā dvitīyasaṃvatsare punar ānayanam asty eveti na kvacid dvaiguṇyaniyamaḥ syāt |
analyzed: ye tu vyācakṣate yā vṛddhiḥ upacitā sāṃvatsarī yugapad sarvā eva ānīyate tatra ayam vidhiḥ yā punar prāpta dānā api sarvā na dīyate tatra adhika grahaṇam api teṣām na na śabdaḥ yathārthaḥ na api āhitaḥ iti sāṃvatsarī tāvat upacitā grāhyā dvitīya saṃvatsare punar ānayanam asti eva iti na kvacid dvaiguṇya niyamaḥ syāt

original: atha yo dviguṇībhūtaṃ salābhaṃ dhanam ānayati tatrādhikaniṣedho 'stu | prāg dvaiguṇyād[326] vṛddhimātradānasamartho[327] vṛddhiṃ dadāti | mūlaṃ tasyāparimitagrahaṇam iti |

analyzed: etat api na kiṃcid yaḥ saṃvahati tasya anugrahaḥ nyāyyaḥ na adhika grahaṇam yaḥ tu rājñā dviguṇībhūtam api kathaṃcid āpyate tasya adhika mokṣaḥ iti etat anyāyyam na ca āhita ityasya śabdasya ayam arthaḥ

original: atha "āhṛtā" iti[330] pāṭhāntaram | tathāpi sakṛcchabdo na niścitārtho nyāyas[331] tu parityaktaḥ svakṛtaś ca pāṭhaḥ syān na mānavī smṛtir ity uktaiva vyavasthā nyāyyā |

original: prakhyātābhijanaḥ kulajaḥ | yasya pitṛpitāmahā vidvāṃso dhārmikā mahāparigrahāḥ svakulāṃśanigṛhītā[558] nākārye pravartante | sa hi svalpām api garhaṇāṃ soḍhum asamarthaḥ | nitarāṃ na[559] ca nindanti janāḥ | vṛttaṃ śīlam ācāro janāpavādabhīrutā svābhāvikam | saṃpannaḥ tad yuktaḥ | dharmajñas tu smṛtipurāṇetihāsābhyāsasaṃjātatadarthāvabodhaḥ | satyavādī bahukṛtvaḥ kāryeṣv adṛṣṭākārye[560] saṃbhāvyamāno vṛttābhidhānaḥ | mahāpakṣaḥ suhṛtsvajanarājāmātyādyanugrahītamahimattvena[561] duṣṭarājādhikāriṇāṃ gamyo na bhavati | dhanī svadhanarakṣārtham adṛṣṭabhayāc ca na paradravyāpahāraṇe vartate: "asti me paryāptaṃ dhanaṃ kiṃ parakīyena, kathaṃcij jñāte daṇḍyaḥ syām" iti | āryo dharmānuṣṭhāyī ṛjuprakṛtir vā | nikṣepam[562] | nikṣipyamāṇaṃ suvarṇādidravyaṃ karmasādhanena ghañocyate | nikṣiped rakṣārthaṃ sthāpayed budhaḥ | evaṃ nikṣipan prājño bhavati | anyathā mūrkhaḥ saṃpadyate |
analyzed: prakhyāta abhijanaḥ kula jaḥ yasya pitṛ pitāmahāḥ vidvāṃsaḥ dhārmikāḥ mahā parigrahāḥ sva kula aṃśa nigṛhītāḥ na akārye pravartante sa hi su alpām api garhaṇām soḍhum asamarthaḥ nitarām na ca nindanti janāḥ vṛttam śīlam ācāraḥ jana apavāda bhīru tā svābhāvikam saṃpannaḥ tat yuktaḥ dharma jñaḥ tu smṛti purāṇa itihāsa abhyāsa saṃjāta tad artha avabodhaḥ satya vādī bahu kṛtvas kāryeṣu adṛṣṭa akārye saṃbhāvyamāna

original: suhṛd bhūtvopadisati dṛṣṭam | nāyam adṛṣṭārtho 'ṣṭakādivad upadeśaḥ | īdṛśi puruṣe nikṣiptasya na vipralayo[563] bhavati, evaṃvidhe na nikṣiptam aneneti śaṅkā na bhavati | yas tu nagnakitavapānaśauñḍādiḥ sa kenacid ākṛṣṭo 'pi matpitrāsya[564] haste nikṣiptaṃ mayā ceti na śaṅkāspadam, suvarṇāder mahato dhanasya nikṣepadhāraka iti | kākaṇī mātrikebhiyujyamāne[565] bhavaty eva || 8.179 ||
analyzed: suhṛd bhūtvā upadisati dṛṣṭam na ayam upadeśaḥ īdṛśi puruṣe nikṣiptasya na vipralayaḥ bhavati evaṃvidhe na nikṣiptam anena iti śaṅkā na bhavati yaḥ tu nagna kitava pāna śauñḍa ādiḥ sa kenacid ākṛṣṭaḥ mad pitrā asya haste nikṣiptam mayā ca iti na śaṅkā āspadam suvarṇa ādeḥ mahataḥ dhanasya nikṣepa dhārakaḥ iti kākaṇī bhavati eva

original: yo yathā nikṣiped dhaste yam arthaṃ yasya mānavaḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ yathā nikṣipet haste yam artham yasya mānavaḥ

original: sa tathaiva grahītavyo yathā dāyas tathā grahaḥ || 8.180 ||
analyzed: sa tathā eva grahītavyaḥ yathā dāyaḥ tathā grahaḥ

original: yatheti, yādṛśena prakāreṇa samudram amudraṃ sasākṣikam asākṣikam ity evamādi, sa tathaiveti | so 'rtho nikṣiptas tathaiva grahītavyaḥ | yathā dāyo dīyate nikṣipyate tathā gṛhyate | yatraitan niścitaṃ bhavati sarvakālam evāsya haste sa mudrayitvā[566] sthāpayati | tatra vipratipattāv amudrite labdhe dhāraṇako yadi bravīti "naiṣa mudrayati nikṣipya me balād gacchati" tatraivaṃ śaṅkāspadaṃ jīyate[567] | pramāṇāntarāt prāyaśo mudraṇam | anyadā tu mudrānāśe kiyad apahāritam iti parimāṇaviśeṣajñānāya pramāṇāntaraṃ vyāpāraṇīyaṃ rājñā | apahnavād[568] eva sāmānyadaṇḍena daṇḍanīyaḥ | nikṣepadaṇḍas tu dravyaparimāṇe niścite dvitīyaḥ |
analyzed: yathā iti yādṛśena prakāreṇa sa mudram amudram sa sākṣikam asākṣikam iti evamādi sa tathā eva iti saḥ rthaḥ nikṣiptaḥ tathā eva grahītavyaḥ yathā dāyaḥ dīyate nikṣipyate tathā gṛhyate yatra etat niścitam bhavati sarvakālam eva asya haste sa mudrayitvā sthāpayati tatra vipratipattau a mudrite labdhe dhāraṇakaḥ yadi bravīti na eṣa mudrayati nikṣipya me balāt gacchati tatra evam śaṅkā āspadam jīyate pramāṇa antarāt prāyaśas mudraṇam anyadā tu

original: nanu ca sarvāpahnava eva vibhāvito jita eva yuktaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ca sarva apahnavaḥ eva vibhāvitaḥ jitaḥ eva yuktaḥ

original: satyam | yatrāvinābhāvasiddham, yathā muṣite grāme devadatto 'bhiyujyate[569] "tvayānyaiś coraiḥ sahāmuṣminn ahani sa grāmo hataḥ" iti | sa āha "naiva tasminn ahani taṃ grāmam aham agamam" | tatra sākṣibhir uktam "dṛṣṭaṃ tasminn ahani tatra yan muṣṭaṃ tat tu na dṛṣṭam" | tatra devadattena moṣo[570] 'py apahnutas tadahar grāmasaṃnidhānasiddheḥ | sphuṭe ca kāraṇāntare saṃnidhāv anupalabhyamāne saṃnidhānādeśadeśāc cauratvam api yuktam anumātum | iha tu pramādanaṣṭānāṃ narāṇāṃ mudritanikṣiptam amudritam eva nīyate |
analyzed: satyam yatra avinābhāva siddham yathā muṣite grāme devadattaḥ bhiyujyate tvayā anyaiḥ coraiḥ saha amuṣmin ahani sa grāmaḥ hataḥ iti saḥ āha na eva tasmin ahani tam grāmam aham agamam tatra sākṣibhiḥ uktam dṛṣṭam tasmin ahani tatra yat muṣṭam tat tu na dṛṣṭam tatra devadattena moṣaḥ api apahnutaḥ tat ahar grāma saṃnidhāna siddheḥ sphuṭe ca kāraṇa antare saṃnidhau anupalabhyamāne saṃnidhāna ādeśa deśāt caura tvam api yuktam anumātum iha

original: yathā dāyas tathā grahaḥ | ko me 'bhiyogāvasara ity anayā buddhyā saṃbhavaty apahnavaḥ | na hi śaknoty anumātum | yadāpi[571] kathaṃcid anumāpayet parimāṇaṃ tu na vinā pramāṇāntaraṃ nikṣiptavacanād eva sidhyatīti yukto divyādito[572] niścayaḥ | sarvathā ya ekadeśāntareṇa na saṃbhavati tatraivaikadeśaparājita iti niścayaḥ || 8.180 ||
analyzed: yathā dāyaḥ tathā grahaḥ kaḥ me bhiyoga avasaraḥ iti anayā buddhyā saṃbhavati apahnavaḥ na hi śaknoti anumātum yadā api kathaṃcid anumāpayet parimāṇam tu na vinā pramāṇa antaram nikṣipta vacanāt eva sidhyati iti yuktaḥ divya āditaḥ niścayaḥ sarvathā yaḥ eka deśa antareṇa na saṃbhavati tatra eva eka deśa parājitaḥ iti niścayaḥ

original: yo nikṣepaṃ yācyamāno nikṣeptur na prayacchati |
analyzed: yaḥ nikṣepam yācyamānaḥ nikṣeptuḥ na prayacchati

original: sa yācyaḥ prāḍvivākena tan nikṣeptur asaṃnidhau || 8.181 ||
analyzed: sa yācyaḥ prāḍvivākena tat nikṣeptuḥ asaṃnidhau

original: vyatyastakramo 'yaṃ ślokaḥ samāmnāye paṭhyate | prathamam asyārdhaślokaṃ paṭhitvā "sākṣyabhāve" (8.182) iti paṭhitavyaṃ, tataḥ "sa yācyaḥ" iti | evaṃ pāṭho yuktaḥ | tathā hy arthasaṅgatir bhavati |
analyzed: vyatyasta kramaḥ yam ślokaḥ samāmnāye paṭhyate prathamam asya ardha ślokam paṭhitvā sākṣī abhāve iti paṭhitavyam tatas sa yācyaḥ iti evam pāṭhaḥ yuktaḥ tathā hi artha saṅgatiḥ bhavati

original: sākṣyabhāvād divyeṣu prāpteṣu vacanam idam | yathā carṇādānādiṣu sākṣyabhāvasamantaram eva divyāni dīyante na tadvad atra | kiṃ tarhi carair asya vṛttam anucārayet | tatra yadi nipuṇataś cāryamāṇō na kvacid vṛtte skalati tadā na śapathair ardanīyaḥ[573] | athāpy atra pramādyati tadā nikṣepaharaṇasāṃbhāvanāpi yuktaiva | tadāyaṃ[574] divyaiḥ pariśodhanīyaḥ | na punar anekanikṣepaharaṇenāparanikṣepaharaṇaṃ sidhyati | kadācid garīyasā prayojanenaikam apahṛtya kṛtaprayojana[575] utpannānuśayo vānyasya samarpayati | ato 'yaṃ ślokasaṃghāto jhaṭ iti nikṣepadhāraṇakasya śapathanivṛtyartho na punaḥ pramāṇopanyāsaḥ | na ca pāḍvivākanikṣepaharaṇe rājadaṇḍavad aniścitāparanikṣepaharaṇe[576] 'pi prathamābhiyoktur dāpayituṃ yuktaḥ | aniścite hi haraṇe dāpyeta yadi śāstreṇa tadā nirṇayārthaṃ vyavahāraśāstraṃ syāt | tataś ca hetubhir nirṇayaḥ kartavya iti virudhyate[577] | tasmān na śāstrīyo 'yam artho[578] na ca laukikī vyavastheti | sākṣyabhāva ityādyuktena prakāreṇānyaparatayā neyam[579] || 8.181 ||
analyzed: sākṣi abhāvāt divyeṣu prāpteṣu vacanam idam yathā ca ṛṇa ādāna ādiṣu sākṣi abhāva samantaram eva divyāni dīyante na tadvat atra kim tarhi caraiḥ asya vṛttam anucārayet tatra yadi nipuṇatas na kvacid vṛtte skalati tadā na śapathaiḥ ardanīyaḥ atha api atra pramādyati tadā nikṣepa haraṇa sāṃbhāvanā api yuktā eva tadā ayam divyaiḥ pariśodhanīyaḥ na punar aneka nikṣepa haraṇena apara nikṣepa haraṇam sidhyati kadācid garīyasā prayojanena eka

original: sākṣyabhāve praṇidhibhir vayorūpasamanvitaiḥ |
analyzed: sākṣī abhāve praṇidhibhiḥ vayaḥ rūpa samanvitaiḥ

original: apadeśaiś ca saṃnyasya hiraṇyaṃ tasya tattvataḥ || 8.182 ||
analyzed: apadeśaiḥ ca saṃnyasya hiraṇyam tasya tattvataḥ

original: padārthayojanām idānīm upasarāmaḥ | sa yācyaḥ prāḍvivākena tannikṣeptur saṃnidhau | yena nikṣeptrā[580] rahasi sthāpitaṃ sākṣiṣv asatsu tasya yācamānasya dhāraṇako yady apahnute "na tvayā kiṃcin nikṣiptam" iti, tato nikṣeptrā[581] rājā jñāpito na nikṣepadhāriṇa ākāraṃ darśayet | kiṃ tarhi kuryāt | praṇidhibhiś cārair hiraṇyam ātmīyaṃ suvarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ vānyasya saṃnyasya nikṣipya yācitavyo 'rthanīyaḥ dvitīyaṃ nikṣepaṃ prāḍvivākena | prāḍvivākagrahaṇaṃ nirṇayādhikṛtapuruṣopalakṣaṇārtham | kiṃ sākṣād eva yācitavyaḥ | nety āha, praṇidhīnāṃ mukhena | yair eva nyastaṃ vayorūpasamanvitaiḥ | vayasā samanvitā[582] yena bālā na bhavanti, teṣāṃ hi paraiḥ preritānāṃ madvañcanārtho nyāsa iti saṃbhāvyate | pariṇatavayobhyas tu nāśaṅkā[583] bhavati | evaṃ rūpasamanvayo vyākhyeyaḥ | rūpam eva kasyacit tādṛśaṃ bhavati yasya darśanād eva cāpalaṃ pratibhāti | tathā ca rūpam etad vyācaṣṭe "bhagavan vītarāgatām" iti | tenaitad[584] uktaṃ bhavati: tādṛśāḥ praṇidhayaḥ kartavyā yeṣāṃ madvañcanārtho 'yam upakrama iti nāśaṅkate dhāraṇakaḥ | apadeśaiḥ savyājair nikṣepakāraṇaiḥ | rājñopadravagrāmagamanādibhi: "anena hetunā tvayi saṃprati nikṣipām" ity anṛtasaṃbhavāt kāraṇakathanam apadeśaḥ | etac ca sarvaṃ prāṅ nikṣeptur asaṃnidhau kartavyam || 8.182 ||
analyzed: padārtha yojanām idānīm upasarāmaḥ sa yācyaḥ prāḍvivākena tad nikṣeptuḥ saṃnidhau yena nikṣeptrā rahasi sthāpitam sākṣiṣu asatsu tasya yācamānasya dhāraṇakaḥ yadi apahnute na tvayā kiṃcid nikṣiptam iti tatas nikṣeptrā rājā jñāpitaḥ na nikṣepa dhāriṇaḥ ākāram darśayet kim tarhi kuryāt praṇidhibhiḥ cāraiḥ hiraṇyam ātmīyam suvarṇam rūpyam vā anyasya saṃnyasya nikṣipya yācitavyaḥ ṛthanīyaḥ dvitīyam nikṣepam prāḍvivāke

original: sa yadi pratipadyeta yathānyastaṃ yathākṛtam |
analyzed: sa yadi pratipadyeta yathānyastam yathākṛtam

original: na tatra vidyate kiṃcid yat parair abhiyujyate || 8.183 ||
analyzed: na tatra vidyate kiṃcid yat paraiḥ abhiyujyate

original: sa yadi nikṣepadhārī yadi pratipadyeta "bāḍham asti, gṛhāṇa" ity aṅgīkṛtya dadyāt | yathanyastaṃ tathā kṛtaṃ samudram amudraṃ yathākṛtaṃ vastrādi saṃvartitam amudritam anyad vā alaṃkārādyanupabhuktaṃ parimalaśūnyaṃ gṛhamudrayā svacihnena sthāpitam | tādṛśam eva ced dadyān na tatra vidyate kiṃcit satyaṃ[585] yat paraiḥ pūrvavedikair abhiyujyate: "etenāsmākīnaḥ sākṣyabhāvān nikṣepo 'pahnūyate" iti | yathānyastaṃ yathākṛtam iti gūḍhāgūḍhacihnakṛtena bhedaḥ | atha vā gṛhītṛnikṣeptṛvyāpārabhedena[586] bhedaḥ | yathākṛtaṃ yathāgṛhītaṃ nirvikalpam avalaṃbaṃ ca gṛhītaṃ tathaiva pratidātvyaṃ pratidāne yatra kālagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta[587] ity arthaḥ || 8.183 ||
analyzed: sa yadi nikṣepa dhārī yadi pratipadyeta bāḍham asti gṛhāṇa iti aṅgīkṛtya dadyāt yathanyastam tathā kṛtam sa mudram a mudram yathā kṛtam vastra ādi saṃvartitam a mudritam anyat vā alaṃkāra ādi anupabhuktam parimala śūnyam gṛha mudrayā sva cihnena sthāpitam tādṛśam eva ced dadyāt na tatra vidyate kiṃcid satyam yat paraiḥ pūrvavedikaiḥ abhiyujyate etena āsmākīnaḥ sākṣī abhāvāt nikṣepaḥ upahnūyate iti yathānyastam yathākṛtam iti gūḍha agū

original: teṣāṃ na dadyād yadi tu tad dhiraṇyaṃ yathāvidhi |
analyzed: teṣām na dadyāt yadi tu tat hiraṇyam yathāvidhi

original: sa nigṛhyobhayaṃ dāpya[588] iti dharmasya dhāraṇā || 8.184 ||
analyzed: sa nigṛhya ubhayam dāpya iti dharmasya dhāraṇā

original: teṣāṃ prāḍvivākaprayuktanikṣeptṝṇāṃ yadi dravyaṃ nikṣiptaṃ na dadyāt, yathāvidhīti yathākṛtapadena vyākhyātam | sa dhāraṇako 'vaṣṭabdhaya[589] rājapuruṣair ubhayam arthino[590] rājanikṣepaṃ ca dāpyaḥ | iti dharmasya dhāraṇā vyavasthā | tātparyam atra vyākhyātam || 8.184 ||
analyzed: teṣām prāḍvivāka prayukta nikṣeptṝṇām yadi dravyam nikṣiptam na dadyāt yathāvidhi iti yathākṛta padena vyākhyātam sa dhāraṇakaḥ rāja puruṣaiḥ ubhayam arthinaḥ rāja nikṣepam ca dāpyaḥ iti dharmasya dhāraṇā vyavasthā tātparyam atra vyākhyātam

original: nikṣepopanidhī nityaṃ na deyau pratyanantare |
analyzed: nikṣepa upanidhī nityam na deyau pratyanantare

original: naśyato vinipāte tāv anipāte tv anāśinau || 8.185 ||
analyzed: naśyataḥ vinipāte tau anipāte tu anāśinau

original: pratyanantare[591] utpattyanantara[592] ucyate nikṣeptuḥ putro bhrātā bhāryā vā, yasya nikṣeptur dravye svāmyam asti — bhāryāyās tāvat svāmyam uktam eva,[593] putrasyāpi paitāmahe bhrātuś caikadhanasya | tatra teṣāṃ kaścid yācen nikṣeptary[594] asaṃnihite "dehi no 'smākīnam etat" iti | tatra kaścid anayā buddhyā dadyāt "sādhāraṇam etad ekena nikṣiptam apareṇa nītam iti ko doṣaḥ" iti | ata ucyate: na deyau nikṣepopanidhī prayanantare | arthavādaṃ[595] hetusarūpam āha: naśyato vinipāte tau | vinipāto 'nyathātvam pratyanantarasya deśāntaragamanādi[596] | tasminn asti tau hīyete | yadi tena nītvā nikṣeptur[597] na dattaṃ tadā tena paryanuyuktasya dhāraṇyakasya kim uttaram | "tvadīyena bhrātraitad dhanaṃ sādhāraṇasvāminā nītam" iti naitad uttaram | "yathā dāyas tathā grahaḥ" (MDh 8.180) ity uktam | yenaiva nikṣiptaṃ svāmināsvāminā vā tasmā eva deyaṃ tasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ | yadi tu pratyanantaro vikriyāṃ na gacchet tadā taddāne 'pi na doṣaḥ | tad āha anipāte tv anāśinau | tatra hy asty uttaraṃ mānaśat[598] tasmād arpayāmi | pratyanantareṇa nīte vinipāte ca tasya nikṣeptre yācamānāya[599] svadhanaṃ dātavyam iti ślokārthaḥ || 8.185 ||
analyzed: pratyanantare utpatti anantara ucyate nikṣeptuḥ putraḥ bhrātā bhāryā vā yasya nikṣeptuḥ dravye svāmyam asti bhāryāyāḥ tāvat svāmyam uktam eva putrasya api paitāmahe bhrātuḥ ca ekadhanasya tatra teṣām kaścid yācet nikṣeptari asaṃnihite dehi no smākīnam etat iti tatra kaścid anayā buddhyā dadyāt sādhāraṇam etat ekena nikṣiptam apareṇa nītam iti kaḥ doṣaḥ iti atas ucyate na deyau nikṣepa upanidhī arthavādam hetu sarūpam āha naśyat arthavādam hetu

original: svayam eva tu yo dadyān mṛtasya pratyanantare |
analyzed: svayam eva tu yaḥ dadyāt mṛtasya pratyanantare

original: na sa rājñābhiyoktavyo[600] na nikṣeptuś ca bandhubhiḥ || 8.186 ||
analyzed: na sa rājñā abhiyoktavyaḥ na nikṣeptuḥ ca bandhubhiḥ
